evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 說文释形 and historical senses
evidence.text: The entry records the received 說文 account 畫也，从八从人，人各有介, and Duan Yucai’s note that dividing entails an interval, explaining 介 as ‘between.’ It separately cites classical examples for ‘between’ (《左傳·襄公九年》), intermediary/introduce (玉篇; 《史記》), aid (玉篇; 《詩經·小雅·小明》), armor (玉篇; 《詩經·大雅·瞻卬》), and armor-wearing (《左傳·襄公二十八年》). These are dictionary-cited textual attestations; they do not by themselves establish a chronological semantic chain. The page also records the received seal-form account, not an independently verified reconstruction of the earliest graph.
evidence.kind: official dictionary account with cited historical usages
evidence.title: [A00076] 介 – Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.field: Current Mandarin reading and historical senses
evidence.text: The entry gives Mandarin jiè. It cites 介 for ‘between’ in 《左傳·襄公九年》 and later texts, and cites other sources for ‘introduce,’ ‘assist,’ ‘armor,’ ‘wear armor,’ shell-bearing aquatic animals, and a classifier equivalent to 個. The dated sequence of those senses is not established by this compilation alone.
evidence.title: [A00076] 介 – Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

search_audit.outcome: Opened search results exposed B-S transcriptions and the official supplementary-materials site. Exact supplied local rows were checked: 介 *kˤr[e]p-s / keajH; 个 *kˤa[r]-s / kaH. No phonetic-component or historical loan claim is supported by those rows.

gaps: The CUHK database’s individual 介 entry could not be opened; its search result supplies a reported graph description and scholarly attribution, not direct page verification.

No underlying oracle-bone inscription images or primary corpus entry were inspected, so individual dates and readings and the meaning of the flanking marks remain unresolved. Accounts include ‘between’ and armor/clothing; no reading here settles the graph’s original construction.

The MOE dictionary cites separate classical examples for ‘between,’ introduce, aid, armor, armor-wearing, shell-bearing animals, and classifier usage, but does not establish a dated chain among these senses. The earliest securely reported sense in this research is ‘between’ in the cited Zuozhuan passage; that textual use does not prove original graphic meaning.

The Warring States 介-for-個 report was not verified in its bamboo-slip edition or a facsimile. Its transcription, exact date, direction of borrowing, and historical sound motivation remain unsettled. Current Mandarin jiè/gè differ, and supplied Baxter–Sagart rows are *kˤr[e]p-s vs *kˤa[r]-s, MC keajH vs kaH; neither current sound nor those rows establish a loan relationship.
Official Unicode Unihan pages for U+4ECB, U+4EBA, and U+4E2A could not be opened. Exact local rows were used as structured data, but cannot be linked to verified official records in this session.

Commons ACC-s00795.svg could not be opened or verified. The 介-seal.svg description page provides claims about identity, sources, and CC0, but the actual SVG pixels could not be inspected, so no candidate glyph is approved.
